name: Plate
summary: For printmakers and illustrators: your name beside a small moving print proof, then your work as a numbered list.
description: For printmakers, risograph and screen printers, zine makers and illustrators who sell editions. The home page opens with your name, tagline and links beside a small square test proof that turns slowly in one ink. Below it, your posts form a numbered list of work, newest first, each picture shown whole with its year and labels.
